answer.book: A single Latin theological treatise, Amandus Polanus's De traditionibus (Basel, 1593), built as a dedication to Count Albert, then a disputation in numbered theses with part headings (general, divine, human and Papist traditions, and Bellarmine's arguments), closed by a prayer to Christ.

entries.title: Ad illustrem et inclytum Dominum, D. Albertum Comitem in Hanavv & Rinnegk, Dominum in Mintzenberg
Hactenus primum Bellarmini pro traditionibus argumentum refutatum est: sequitur secundum.
Et hactenus de traditione divina: sequitur de humana.
Huc usque in genere de traditionibus: sequitur jam in specie de traditionibus Papisticis.
